svg.aria-label: SYNTHWERK_<SERVICE>_<NAME>: Every setting is an env var with this shape (D-40). See .env.example. SYNTHWERK_PLATFORM_ENV, OTEL_*: Environment name (local here). Services get the standard OTEL_* names from compose. SYNTHWERK_WAF_ENGINE: On blocks. DetectionOnly logs matches without blocking. SYNTHWERK_WAF_PARANOIA_LEVEL: CRS paranoia level, 1 to 4. Default 1
